title: Mimoglad Office Chair, High Back Ergonomic Desk Chair with Adjustable Lumbar Support and Headrest, Swivel Task Chair with flip-up Armrests for Guitar Playing, 5 Years Warranty

reviews.title: Great Chair, priced well and perfect for shorter people or women.
reviews.body: Overall, I am pleased with this chair as my new office chair.  As I work from home and need to spend extended periods sitting at my computer, the chair has been comfortable for me. It is not too heavy, tall, or wide like some office chairs. I am a slender female, 5'5". The chair's quality appears to be good, is stable, sturdy, and it has helped me maintain proper posture.The chair was easy to assemble and arrived in a compact box. The materials appear to be of good quality for the price, and I had no difficulty assembling the chair myself.The support team was very helpful and responded quickly after I sent an email to register the warranty. They offered to send me a complimentary cushion, and I just received the lumbar cushion. It added more comfort and support.In conclusion, I am very pleased with my purchase, and I have not experienced any issues with the chair. I hope it continues to function properly for years to come..​

reviews.title: Very Comfortable, Great Color, Nice Adjustable Head Rest - Great for shorter people or women
reviews.body: Love this chair! I had been searching for an alternative to a chair I had found in store that I really liked, though it was overpriced and not the best comfort. As a shorter and small female(5'5", 130lbs), I often have a hard time finding comfortable chairs that are not super huge or too tiny and uncomfortable; especially when it comes to the lumbar or head rest placement. This chair from Mimoglad however, has checked all of my boxes and needs! It is ergonomic, has a nice mesh back but a very thick and wide cushion for the seat (great for those that like to sit cross-legged as well) as well as a very adjustable head rest that isn't too firm or too soft. (It seems they have updated the head rest from the one in photo on the website, as this one is much more adjustable, see photo) It's perfect for long hours of sitting at your desk or leaning back to watch a show! I also love that the arms can be put up as well, as sometimes I like to have them down, while other times I can just lift them up if they get in the way. Overall I'm very satisfied with this chair, and it's a huge bonus that it comes with a 5 year warranty. It's so hard to find office chairs that are not that ugly pastel pink, and I love the hot pink color of this chair! I would definitely recommend it to others that are smaller/shorter, though I do not think it would work well for a tall/larger person. It was also extremely easy to put together. I cannot comment on the durability as I have not had it long, though with the long warranty I don't see that being an issue at all.

reviews.title: Comfortable but could use better lumbar support
reviews.body: The Mimoglad High Back Ergonomic Office Chair is overall a solid choice—comfortable, easy to assemble, and looks great in my workspace. However, I do wish it offered more lumbar support. For longer work sessions, the lower back support just isn’t as strong as I’d like.Still, it’s a good chair for the price and works well if you just need something comfortable and functional without all the extra bells and whistles.

reviews.title: Perfect chair for sewing!
reviews.body: I needed a new chair for my quilt room so that I didn't have to swap my office chair back and forth every time I wanted to sew (I work from home in another room).  After what felt like weeks of researching ergonomic chairs, that could hold up to 300 pounds, swiveled, and weren't extremely expensive, I found this awesome chair, and BONUS, it was pink (my 2nd favorite color). I decided, based on reading many reviews here on Amazon and Google, to take a chance and order it.  The box arrived a bit damaged from shipping with some holes and crushed in spots, but after pulling out all the pieces there was no damage to the actual chair parts. My husband was able to put the chair together in less than 30 minutes and said it was extremely easy.  Upon first sitting in it I wasn't so sure because I have a wide backside and am used to sitting in my "Shaq" Serta Big and Tall chair I purchased over 5 years ago that is now leaning to the left (due to the way I like to sit) and this chair is much more narrow.  However, I love the support this chair gives my back, particularly the lumbar region since I have had surgery and need the support.  The chair is comfortable to sit in, the seat is fabric so I can sit in it with shorts on and not stick to it during the humid summers here in the South, which I love!  We did replace the caster wheels with rubber rollerblade-type wheels to help the chair move smoothly on the quilt room floor but the original caster wheels worked just fine before we changed them out. The only negative, for me, is that while the height is adjustable, for a short person like me, I'm 5'5, the lowest setting is about 2 inches too high and my legs hang.  My fault for not paying full attention to the dimensions.  The chair still works though since my sewing machine foot is about the same height and I put my footrest to the left so that I can rest my left foot on it, making it perfect for me.  Overall this is a fantastic chair that anyone would be comfortable in!

reviews.author: Kerensa

reviews.title: WHAT'S NOT TO LOVE??!!
reviews.body: Soooooo....it's PINK, Black and White...swivels 360, has moveable arms, reclining feature, adjustable height, headrest AND lumbar support?Dude...what's not to LOVE??💜I've had all kinds of chairs...HAD to try this one! I feel so modern.This is a pretty cool chair...once u figure out the position points that work for u. That's always the fun part...tailoring all to fit your unique style.And it's cuuuute!!! 🙂 💋 Matches my office decor. Hey, the company even threw in some white gloves to wear while u are initially constructing it. Thank u 4 thinking of my nails that I just did. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 lol.I liked the packaging....easy to tell what is what, with labeled parts, and an easy to follow booklet. I'm a pretty good "fix it" girl that can follow the HECK outta some CLEAR CUT directions. These directions were just that!! Easy to assemble? Basically. I sometimes have a beast of a time lining up the screws with the holes when holding weighted objects. The brackets to the seat was like....come ON, mannnnn...but I got it!!!All worth it!!!I am 5'5, so the chair features work for me....easily....and I can literally rock back and forth if I want to, or just recline! The bottom tension mechanism is easy to adjust. Oh...and the chair can lift pretty high, as well...for slightly taller desks.I also use a footrest....which works well with this chair.The material seems breathable. That is a plus, as my office can run hot sometimes.So far, this chair is light and comfy and supports my head and neck well.What I need to do, though, is add some pink or black and white fur cuffs to the arm rests. Otherwise, BAYBEE...the material is gonna make my elbows ashy on short sleeve days FOR SURE!!! No sirrrrr!! Can't have THAT!!This is definitely a GOOD chair, though. My daughter also bought one for her office and loves it. Pink, of course!Overall....this chair is really cool....I dig it, happy I bought it and I do highly recommend it:))⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 10, 2022
reviews.author: IndiBlue

reviews.title: Exceptional Customer Service
reviews.body: Comfortable, fairly easy to assemble, operates smoothly, seems durable enough, looks great. Had some trouble figuring out how to lift the chair at 1st (user error). It was a little different than other office chairs I'd used in the past and I thought I had a faulty gas lift, but customer service was on it, reached out to me and addressed every issue I had (thanks, Bonnie!). If I could improve the experience, I would suggest including operation instructions for the assembled chair in the assembly instructions. I would also reccommend for anyone wanting to use the seat cover, put that on BEFORE screwing the seat into the frame (that was not in the instructions, either). Other than that, satisfied with this chair and hope to have it for a very long time.
